expanded_prompts.sm-enigma-015-default-attempt001-prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original creature portrait sprite for a 2D creature-raising game
Primary request: Create exactly one full-body creature following the complete independent brief below. This is a new design; do not base it on any existing character.
Management only, do not render text: sm-enigma-015 / オクノビラ / 謎体 (enigma)
Body and exact anatomy: 体幹4節の底のある角丸菱形枠が前後に入れ子状につながる形。脚0本、最前節に目2個、翼0枚、尾3本
Materials and biological motif: 奥行きが穏やかに伸びる厚い膜。小さな岩穴の奥行きを確かめるように伸び縮みする
Primary, secondary, accent colors respectively: #9DB5CB; #BA9771; #DDD0E7
Three mandatory visual identifiers: 四枠は奥へ行くほど一段ずつ小さい; 最奥の第四節だけ穴がなく平らに閉じる; 三本尾は最前節の下辺から中央が長く伸びる
Pose: 四段の奥行きが見える斜め正面を向き、三本尾を床に添える
Temperament to convey through expression or posture: 好奇心旺盛。奥へ伸びる前に周りの空間をゆっくり確かめる. If the brief specifies zero eyes or no face, do not invent eyes or facial features; express temperament through posture only.
Style: cohesive hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration, clear dark colored contour, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, appealing natural creature proportions, clean readable form.
Composition: isolated single creature, full body; by default use a slight top-down three-quarter view facing toward image-right. If the individual pose explicitly requires a front or top view, that explicit pose takes priority. Preserve the specified pose and physical left/right features. Centered in a square canvas, no cropping. Keep transparent padding on all sides. Intended final canvas is 1024 by 1024 pixels, with the longest creature extent about 768–896 pixels and at least 64 pixels of clear padding.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no diffuse glow. Habitat, rocks, water surfaces and action scenery mentioned in the brief describe only body posture or temperament; do not render those objects or environments.
Constraints: preserve exact anatomy, all three identifiers and the position of the palette colors; no costume or held tool unless explicitly part of the brief.
Individual forbidden changes: 五段以上へ増やさない; 最奥に別の世界や生物を描かない; 枠を金属の機械装置にしない
Avoid: extra creatures, humans, text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, gradients bleeding into the transparent area, photorealism, 3D render, imitation of an existing character.
expanded_prompts.sm-enigma-015-default-attempt002-prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1 is the edit target sm-enigma-015. Change only the rendering of light and shade: simplify the softly blended multi-layer shading into restrained clean three-step cel shading (base, one shadow, one light per existing material color), preserving the exact current structure. Keep exactly four thick soft rounded-diamond frame body segments nested in depth, progressively smaller toward the back, with the fourth/backmost segment flat and closed with no hole. Keep exactly two eyes only on the foremost segment, zero legs, zero wings, three tails attached to its lower edge with the middle tail longest. Preserve the oblique-front pose showing four-depth steps, color roles #9DB5CB primary, #BA9771 secondary, #DDD0E7 accent, and organic thick membrane material. No new frame, creature, distant scene, metal machinery, props, text, scenery or cast shadow. Full body centered on genuine transparent background with generous clear padding. Do not redesign or change the count of the frames or tails.
expanded_prompts.sm-enigma-015-default-attempt003-prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1 is the current sm-enigma-015 edit target. Correct only the body depth arrangement: the four progressively smaller rounded-diamond membrane frames must form one connected nested recess, with the fourth/backmost segment a flat closed bottom visible through the first three frames. Reposition the rear three frames along the same depth axis behind the front opening, rather than spread them far sideways. The opening inside the foremost frame should reveal successively smaller frame interiors and the solid fourth bottom, not transparent background through a disconnected gap. Show exactly four stages, no fifth frame. Keep the foremost frame with two eyes, exactly three tails from its lower edge with the middle longest, zero legs and zero wings. Preserve soft thick membrane material, #9DB5CB blue primary, #BA9771 tan secondary, #DDD0E7 light accent, current clean three-step cel shading, and an oblique front view that clearly shows the nested depth. The backdrop outside the creature stays genuinely transparent; no other world, scene, creature, text, machine, ground or cast shadow. Do not alter tail count or eye placement.
expanded_prompts.sm-enigma-015-pixel-attempt001-prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: one authentic pixel-art creature sprite, a paired rendition of the approved original illustration
Input image 1: the approved default illustration for sm-enigma-015; it is the identity reference and must remain the same creature.
Primary request: Redraw this exact creature as carefully constructed pixel art. Change only the rendering medium. Do not invent a replacement design and do not merely downsample or apply a pixelation filter to the input.
Management only, do not render text: sm-enigma-015 / オクノビラ / 謎体 (enigma)
Locked body and anatomy: 体幹4節の底のある角丸菱形枠が前後に入れ子状につながる形。脚0本、最前節に目2個、翼0枚、尾3本
Locked material cues: 奥行きが穏やかに伸びる厚い膜。小さな岩穴の奥行きを確かめるように伸び縮みする
Locked palette roles, primary/secondary/accent: #9DB5CB; #BA9771; #DDD0E7
All three identifiers must remain recognizable: 四枠は奥へ行くほど一段ずつ小さい; 最奥の第四節だけ穴がなく平らに閉じる; 三本尾は最前節の下辺から中央が長く伸びる
Locked pose: 四段の奥行きが見える斜め正面を向き、三本尾を床に添える
Locked temperament/expression: 好奇心旺盛。奥へ伸びる前に周りの空間をゆっくり確かめる. Preserve eyeless or faceless designs without adding eyes or a face; for those designs use posture to convey temperament.
Rendering: an intentional 128 by 128 logical pixel grid, readable pixel clusters, controlled staircase contours, consistent 1–2 logical pixel outline, limited palette no more than 32 visible colors, hard-edged opaque pixels and transparent background pixels only. Preserve exact counts of eyes, limbs, wings, tails and other declared structures. Simplify surface texture, never delete identity features or invent anatomy.
Composition: match the reference's facing, pose, relative color placement and body proportions. Full body, centered, longest creature extent about 96–112 logical pixels, at least 8 logical pixels of transparent padding on every side. No cropped body parts.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no backdrop, no shadow, no glow spilling out of the silhouette. Do not render any habitat, rock, water surface or action scenery mentioned in the brief; depict only the creature and its posture.
Individual forbidden changes: 五段以上へ増やさない; 最奥に別の世界や生物を描かない; 枠を金属の機械装置にしない
Avoid: antialiasing, blur, smooth gradients, semitransparent pixels, inconsistent pixel sizes, painterly miniatures, pixelation overlays, extra characters, text, letters, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, redesign.
